_why: Which models can actually be shown a picture. One file, three readers: the page (a copy, compared by lab/page-check.mjs), lab/vision.py (the instrument that measures and records), and wake/wake.py (which refuses to hand a picture to a model that cannot see). A model absent from this file is unmeasured, and unmeasured is treated as blind — a picture sent to a blind model returns a reply, not an error, and the reply describes a photograph that never arrived.
